derived_quantities.description: Higher of actual (billed) weight and the 25 kg minimum chargeable weight

charges.label: Freight (chargeable weight x per-kg rate)
charges.quote: consignments under 50 kg: ₹9.50 per kg of chargeable weight; consignments over 50 kg: ₹8.25 per kg of chargeable weight

charges.label: Protected-handling fee for fragile consignments
charges.quote: Consignments booked as fragile are handled under the Carrier's protected-handling process at ₹150.00 per consignment, in addition to freight.

accessorials_policy.clause: alpine-express.md (no clause states unlisted charges are unpayable)

invoice_adjustments.label: 5% discount for months with more than 12 consignments
invoice_adjustments.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

ambiguities.description: The rate card gives ₹9.50/kg for consignments 'under 50 kg' and ₹8.25/kg for consignments 'over 50 kg'. Chargeable weight of exactly 50 kg falls in neither band and is not priced by this contract.

notes: Only two charges are named in the contract: base freight (tiered per-kg rate on chargeable weight, with a 25 kg minimum) and a flat ₹150 fragile-handling fee. Express service is explicitly not offered (§3), so service_level=express has no corresponding rate. Special handling types cold_chain and residential are not mentioned anywhere in the contract and therefore attract no charge. A genuine rate-card gap exists at exactly 50 kg chargeable weight (neither 'under 50' nor 'over 50'); recorded in ambiguities. accessorials_policy.closed_list is set to false because the contract contains no statement that charges outside its schedule are unpayable (it simply does not mention any others). §6 (monthly invoicing, 30-day payment terms) and §7 (60 days' notice for rate revisions) are administrative/procedural and do not affect line pricing, so no document_rules entries were created for them.
